# Atira Tan

> Atira Tan offers trauma-informed somatic education and plant medicine facilitator training for creating safer, more integrated communities.

Atira Tan specializes in somatic therapy and psychedelic-assisted healing through comprehensive certificate training programs. The platform combines trauma-informed approaches with plant medicine integration, designed for facilitators and integration practitioners seeking professional development.

## Key Topics

- Somatic Trauma Education
- Plant Medicine Facilitation
- Trauma-Informed Care
- Somatic Integration
- Psychedelic Training
- Facilitator Certification
- Integration Practitioner
- Somatic Therapy
- Professional Development
- Self-Paced Learning
- 85-Hour Certificate Training
- 50-Hour Integration Training
- Safer Communities

## Certificate Training Programs

- [Atira Tan: Somatic Trauma Education for a Safer World](https://learn.atiratan.com/offers/uDsFuhY7): Trauma-informed plant medicine facilitator & somatic integration certificate training
